BL-861 — A sibling deferral is never released when its blocker closes, and the check it recorded stops being runnable at that exact moment — BL-574 stranded on main with no QA verdict
What it solves: Live victim is BL-574, which is spec-complete, built, and on `main` but still
sits in `backlog/active/` with no QA verdict. BL-574 needs a QA re-entry and
a corrected `assigned_to:` — both coordinator-routed, reported by note
2026-08-09, and deliberately NOT folded into this ticket.
Approval context: Sign-off wanted on severity `high`. The argument for high: this silently strands a COMPLETED ticket. BL-574's code has been on `main` since 2026-08-08, both its blockers passed QA and closed, and it still holds one of three active slots with no QA verdict and no runnable path to earn one. That is c…
BL-861 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-861" (or "reject BL-861 <reason>") to act.
